answer: At dawn, a procurement agent checks offers for hollow molds from a forge through several independently operated relay keys pinned during setup. It reserves connections to those relays and authenticates their messages; unsolicited peers cannot evict them. A swarm of fake relay identities therefore cannot fill every connection slot and isolate the buyer from honest offers. This limits sybil eclipse attacks, provided at least one pinned relay stays honest and reachable; it does not validate offer quality.
